results.name: restock advice from the analyst
results.reply:
Restock maize meal 10 kg – you have 4 packs left and the reorder point is 3, so order at least 2 more to stay safe. Restock eggs (tray of 30) – you have 3 trays, reorder point is 2, add 2 trays to keep a buffer. Restock candles (pack of 6) – you have 3 packs, exactly at the reorder point, order 1 more pack.  

Selling slowly: salt 1 kg moved only 2 units in the last 7 days, rice 2 kg moved 3 units, and eggs (tray of 30) moved just 6 units. These items turn over slowly and may not need large orders until demand picks up.
